scope: KA2/RK3588 loggerd/encoderd rotation liveness and per-output failure containment, including isolated synthetic DMA-BUF and rejected-input lifecycle coverage (r9)
reason: Assessed against report_architecture_r9.md (sha256 a788e36c49a30aceb4e8bacaa97040db7eb20c5c0d5340f33fe878fc9a68b886) and report_interfaces_r9.md (sha256 2ef10c8c8964203da994dd6d1b4a47db238820c3210ec365ca700f35365f007c). The additive LoggerdRotationReport schema is written only by loggerd after deterministic-KA2 runtime commits and is explicitly diagnostic; the existing LoggerdRotateState, LoggerdSegment, and LoggerdSegmentEpoch remain the only segment authority. The report introduces no external actor, credential, public endpoint, privilege transition, cereal schema, or new IPC mechanism, and does not move the existing local Params trust boundary. Its exact seven top-level fields are route, epoch, segment, degraded, missing_streams, elapsed_ms, and known_drop_counts. The nested drop object has exactly five fixed nonnegative integer keys: stale_video_messages, future_video_queue_drops, audio_no_writer_events, audio_expired_events, and audio_capacity_drops. These counters describe loggerd-observed drops only; encoder-side MPP rejection, stall, drain, pending-frame, and retry losses remain per-output encoderd logs/counters and are not copied into this report. For audio, reject the newest whole rawAudioData event atomically if it would exceed the 256 KiB cap, leave the existing timestamp-ordered FIFO queue unchanged, do not split payloads or evict older entries, and count the event once as audio_capacity_drops. For accepted queued events, expiry and commit/no-writer are disjoint terminal causes: whichever occurs first owns the count, with expiry winning an exact monotonic-deadline tie. No diagnostic value may control segment authority, select a path, or contain frame payloads, secrets, or filesystem paths. The synthetic DMA-heap VisionIPC publisher and invalid-input/fault cases are test-only and must use isolated roots. Therefore r9 introduces or moves no adversarial trust boundary. This finding does not qualify the existing DMA-BUF, live V4L2 exporter, MPP driver, fences, synchronization, or buffer-reuse behavior; those remain explicitly unqualified. Build must preserve single-import/no-copy behavior, bounded queues and retries, exact pending-frame retirement, segment-checked writes, static stream-name handling, diagnostic-only consumption, and test-root isolation. Reassess if the report is exposed outside the existing local Params readers or is later used for control decisions.
